profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building distributed, cloud-based enterprise systems across financial services, healthcare, and insurance domains. Experienced in Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and large-scale backend systems with strong focus on reliability, observability, and system scalability. Proven ability to design and deliver production-grade services, modernize legacy systems, and support distributed applications in cloud environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained distributed enterprise applications supporting high-scale business-critical systems. 
• Built three production applications from scratch across full SDLC including architecture, development, testing, and deployment. 
• Developed automated testing frameworks improving release reliability and reducing manual validation effort. 
• Led cloud-native deployment modernization using AWS ROSA and OpenShift container platform. 
• Implemented observability across 7 applications using Dynatrace and Splunk, improving system monitoring and issue detection. 
• Performed production incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis across distributed services. 
• Contributed to system performance improvements, reliability enhancements, and operational readiness. 
• Collaborated on system design, requirements breakdown, and Agile delivery across cross-functional teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Spring Boot

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
• Architected and built full-stack distributed application platform using Angular and Firebase. 
• Developed authentication, event systems, profiles, and job posting modules. 
• Led product architecture, technical design, and feature prioritization. 
• Managed cloud-hosted backend services and frontend applications. 
• Iteratively improved platform based on user feedback and performance needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Capital One Project
• Supported migration of Java/Spring Boot applications to AWS cloud infrastructure. 
• Assisted in modernization of distributed backend services and deployment pipelines. 
• Resolved complex configuration and deployment issues in cloud environments. 
• Collaborated with global engineering teams on system architecture and cloud adoption. 
• Supported CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows.

Exact Sciences Project
• Developed and maintained distributed integration services using MuleSoft and DataWeave. 
• Built APIs supporting healthcare data exchange and enterprise system integration. 
• Improved system reliability and performance through enhancements and refactoring. 
• Acted as technical lead for initiatives within Agile teams. 
• Supported system design, release planning, and stakeholder communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Services API · MuleSoft Anypoint Platform · Unit Testing

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.locationName: St Louis Park, Minnesota, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed Java/Spring Boot applications supporting financial systems. 
• Debugged and resolved defects in enterprise legacy systems. 
• Supported modernization and refactoring initiatives. 
• Collaborated with engineering teams on feature delivery and system improvements.

positions.title: Human Resources Director
positions.description: As a Human Resources Director, I was a member of the administrative team. My duties included but were not limited to, new hire recruitment, training, staff documentation and benefit preparation. I communicated with staff on issues they are having and how the work place can be a more welcoming environment. I have worked on various projects which included meeting reports, staff retreat documentation, stay interview analysis and the reshaping of the training program with an updated interface.

positions.title: Community Engagement Director
positions.description: As the Community Engagement Director, I am the liaison between outside organizations and Coulee Connections. The projects that I have completed have been updating the company website,  creating relationships with local schools in regards to employment and internship opportunities and publicizing Coulee Connections in the community.

positions.title: Employment Specialist
positions.description: As an Employment Specialist I would collaborate with organizations within the community to find individuals with disabilities and disadvantages employment. I continually keep in contact with businesses and funding sources to establish realistic processes and goals for our consumers. I use time keeping software to keep track of billing and hours for each consumer on my caseload to use company resources wisely. Monthly reports are used to record the progress of our consumers at a work site and communicate with our funding sources.

positions.title: Scheduler/Trainer/Volunteer Coordinator
positions.description: I created and maintained accurate schedules by collaborating with department leads. I would make shift changes, ensure proper billing and communicate with staff on a daily basis. I would provide company wide software support for all employees with the Human Resources and time keeping software. As a Trainer I taught the company training courses to new and old staff members. As the Volunteer Coordinator, I interviewed and screened new volunteers and interns to help aid our staff members with day to day tasks.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description: I would sign up customers for our rewards program to remain loyal and acquire  discounts and coupons. I would perform refunds and exchanges for customers while encouraging them to return or find other products. Make products tidy at the checkout lane and help with product floor plans to be highly presentable towards customers.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: I directed and trained a team of individuals within the movie theater. I have provided support and constructive criticism in a team based environment. I worked closely with other managerial staff to collaborate ways to enhance the customer's experience at our movie theater.

positions.title: Microsoft Representative
positions.description: I was trained extensively on customer support and product sales. I provided expert advice on what to look for in computers and made the customer confident in the purchasing process. I allowed other employees to shadow me while I worked with customers to maximize training efficiency.

projects.title: Bolin Virtual Work Environment
projects.description: The project had us discuss what changes were going to happen to a company if they go to a virtual work place. We explained what the challenges and opportunities would arise that the company would face. We also discussed on what the leadership and employees need to do when they move to a virtual workplace.

projects.title: International Business Joint Venture Project
projects.description: This project had me look into the complexities and social aspects of creating a joint venture between two companies. The companies were Mercedes-Benz of Germany and Mahindra and Mahindra Motors of India. It was a hypothetical business idea of bring the two companies together to manufacture smart cars in India. I had to discuss the legal aspects involved in making this venture and also how it would affect the environment of both companies and countries.
